translation: (Averse to astragalus 黃芪, dried ginger 乾薑, 乾漆, cornus 山茱萸, and jujube 大棗.) Original text of the Benjing: Cynanchum (白薇), flavor bitter, level. It chiefly treats sudden wind-stroke with body heat and distending fullness, sudden unconsciousness (忽忽不知人), mania-delusion pathogenic qi, and cold-heat with soreness ...
